contentHtml:
SAUDI ARABIA—Magrabi Health has opened a new Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT) department at its Day Surgery Hospital in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to expand access to specialized care for adults and children and strengthen its medical services portfolio.

The department provides diagnostic, surgical and audiology services for a range of ear, nose and throat conditions.

It is equipped with modern medical technology and staffed by specialized medical professionals to support the diagnosis and treatment of patients.

Its surgical services include endoscopic sinus surgery, correction of a deviated nasal septum, tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy.

The latter procedures are particularly relevant for children experiencing snoring or breathing difficulties during sleep.

The department also offers hearing assessments and audiology services, supported by dedicated operating rooms for ENT procedures.

Expanded specialist capacity

Mutasim Alireza, Chief Executive Officer of Magrabi Health, said the new department forms part of the group’s efforts to expand its medical specialties and respond to growing demand for specialized healthcare.

He noted that investments in qualified medical professionals and modern technologies would support service delivery and improve the quality of patient care.

Meanwhile, Abdulrahman Barzangi, Deputy Chief Executive Officer and Chief Operating Officer, said the department has four fully equipped consultation clinics operating from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.

The extended operating hours are intended to improve access and provide greater flexibility for patients seeking ENT and audiology services.

The facility can also accommodate increasing patient volumes while maintaining organized patient flow.

Mohammed Kamel, Consultant and Chief of the ENT Unit, said the department brings together specialist doctors, consultants and supporting teams in audiology, nursing and technical services.

This multidisciplinary approach supports patient assessment, diagnosis and treatment planning for both adults and children, taking into account their individual medical needs.

Day surgery model

The new department forms part of Magrabi Health’s day surgery model, which allows eligible patients to undergo surgical procedures and return home on the same day without an overnight hospital stay.

The process begins with a specialist consultation and diagnostic examinations, followed by an individualized treatment plan.

Patients then undergo a pre-anaesthesia assessment and receive instructions ahead of surgery.

After the procedure, medical teams monitor their recovery before discharge, providing home care guidance and follow-up appointments to support continued care.

Expansion plans for 2027

Magrabi Health also plans to expand its healthcare network in 2027 through new facilities in Al Marwah district in Jeddah and Madinah, alongside an independent centre in Al Narjis district in Riyadh.

The expansion programme includes introducing ENT services at the Madinah branch and the Al Narjis centre.

These investments will extend the group’s specialist care footprint and increase access to ENT services across additional Saudi markets.

The expansion aligns with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 healthcare transformation agenda, which prioritizes greater access to specialized services, improved care quality and increased private sector participation in healthcare delivery.
